text: common mode machine instance A ‘common mode machine instance’ is a special ‘mode machine instance’ shared by BSW Modules and SW-Cs: The RTE Generator creates only one mode machine instance if a ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype instantiated in a port of a software-component is synchronized (synchronizedModeGroup of a SwcBswMapping) with a providedModeGroup ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype of a Basic Software Module instance. The related mode machine instance is called common mode machine instance.

targets.why: Defines common mode machine instance creation.
Relates synchronized ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype to mode machine.
